note: The standard simulation and probe protocol applied to every site twin (lengths in mm unless the key says m; angles in deg; times in s). Walk probes use the robot instrument's own settings (robot/), not these.

sim.note: mjOption is reset to MuJoCo's defaults first (density, viscosity, wind, magnetic, flags, o_* overrides), then these values are applied. tolerance 1e-10: with a kinematic body in a contact island the Newton solver stopped early at 1e-8 and light bodies rocked

classes.note: units touch units, the environment and the gates; a gate never touches the environment (it slides along its rail); visual geoms (contype = conaffinity = 0) stay non-colliding

kinematic.note: held units and every gate get this armature on their dofs (then mj_setConst) and have qpos/qvel written before every step; every other dof has no armature, damping or friction loss, every joint no stiffness, every body no gravity compensation, every geom no surface velocity, adhesion or fluid coefficients. 1e7 because site units weigh up to tonnes

settle.note: first a quasi-static relaxation of relax_s (step, then every velocity set to zero; gates held, units free: penetrations are pushed out without a launch, small gaps close without an impact), then the dynamic settle of seconds; motion is sampled at every step of both phases against the submitted pose (so what the relaxation moves counts as drift); gates are held at their photographed position; the explosion flag looks at the first explode_window_s of the dynamic phase. G0's settle check (twin_gate.settle_check) runs the same relaxation before its own dynamic window

static.note: a unit is static when, over the settle, the displacement of its collision-geometry centroid stays within pos_mm and its rotation within rot_deg (maxima over every step)

measure.point: collision-geometry centroid (geom centres weighted by the volume of their bounding boxes; the body COM for a unit without colliding geoms)
measure.rotation: angle of the body's rotation relative to the start (frame-independent)

lift.note: each probed unit is driven kinematically by lift_mm along the twin's +z (minimum jerk over rise_s / speed, then held hold_s) from the settled state; every other unit is free

outcome.note: carried: the unit follows the lifted one (rise >= carried_rise_mm, |d - d_lifted| <= carried_tol_mm, rotation < follow_max_deg); stayed: |d| < stay_mm and rotation < stay_deg; disturbed: |d| >= disturbed_mm (moves more than 2 cm) or rotation >= disturbed_deg, and not following; anything else is intermediate (never scored)

gate_rule.note: the travel rule of a sliding gate (twin_sim.gate_rule): a limited slide, the photographed position (qpos0) inside the range, a total travel of min_width_ratio..max_width_ratio x the leaf's width along the slide (the extent of its collision geometry), at least min_open_m of free travel beyond qpos0 in the opening direction (the side on which the rail continues beyond the leaf), and at most max_closing_m of travel beyond qpos0 the other way, plus what the real gate itself can travel that way (nothing for a gate the photos show shut)
